guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：雷射散斑抑制
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Laser-speckle reduction
guides.concept: 從雷射照在粗糙屏幕上的隨機相量和出發，理解散斑對比 C = σ/⟨I⟩ 為何只能靠疊加獨立圖樣以 1/√N 降低，再把角度、偏振與波長多樣性、移動擴散片、多模光纖、等效人眼相機、投影鏡頭光展量與壽命驗收整合成可交接的散斑抑制工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the random phasor sum of laser light on a rough screen to see why speckle contrast C = σ/⟨I⟩ falls only as 1/√N by stacking independent patterns, then integrate angle, polarization and wavelength diversity, moving diffusers, multimode fibers, eye-equivalent cameras, projection-lens étendue and lifetime acceptance into a transferable speckle-reduction record.
procedure: 同調光照到粗糙度大於波長的屏幕時，觀察者每個解析單元內都有大量隨機相位的散射子波，它們在視網膜或感測器上做複數相加，形成隨機相量和。當相位完全隨機且散射子很多時，強度服從負指數分布，散斑對比 C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1，稱為完全發展的散斑；去偏振屏幕把光分成兩個獨立偏振的散斑圖，C 降到 1/√2。人眼看到的是主觀散斑，顆粒大小由觀察者瞳孔而非屏幕決定，所以同一畫面在明亮環境下瞳孔縮小時，散斑更粗、更明顯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「屏幕粗糙面與觀察者瞳孔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

降低散斑的唯一途徑，是在觀察者的一個解析單元與一個積分時間內疊加 N 個彼此不相關、強度相近的散斑圖；強度相加使 C = 1/√N。獨立圖樣來自三種多樣性：照明角度（投影光瞳相對觀察者瞳孔的立體角比）、偏振（最多 2 個圖樣）與波長（光源頻寬相對屏幕路徑差所需的去相關波長）。三者相乘得總縮減因子 R = R_角·R_偏·R_λ，每一項都有物理上限，所以設計要先把目標 C 換算成所需的 N，再分配給各項。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「角度、偏振與波長多樣性」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

角度多樣性要在時間上實現，最常見的元件是放在中間像面或光瞳附近的移動擴散片：擴散片每移動一個相關長度，屏幕上的散斑就換成一個新的獨立圖樣。旋轉擴散片速度高，但體積大且有軸承壽命問題；以電活性聚合物膜驅動的小型擴散片用 x、y 兩組電極以 90° 相位差產生圓周運動，避免線性往返在折返點停頓並重走相同路徑。關鍵在於：時間上的圖樣再多，有效 N 仍受投影光瞳能容納的角度數 N_角 封頂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「移動擴散片與相關長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

另一條路是讓光源本身攜帶多樣性：多發射體雷射二極體陣列天生有波長分散，調變驅動電流也能展寬譜線；多模光纖則把光分到數以萬計的模態，各模態的群速度不同。但模態彼此仍是同調的，只有當模態間的最大光程差大於光源同調長度時，光纖出口才會變成多個互不相干的散斑圖，所以單頻雷射進多模光纖依舊滿是散斑。階躍折射率光纖的模態色散遠大於漸變折射率光纖，在去散斑用途上反而是優點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多模光纖與光源頻寬」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑對比不是屏幕或光源的固有數字，而是對特定偵測器定義的量：偵測器孔徑決定顆粒大小與能收集多少角度多樣性，像素大小決定空間積分，曝光時間決定時間平均。要評估人眼感受，量測相機必須模擬眼睛：放在觀看位置、入瞳直徑等於瞳孔、對焦於屏面、每個顆粒至少兩個像素取樣、曝光接近眼睛的積分時間。任何一項不匹配都會讓 C 被系統性高估或低估，而且不同實驗室的數字無法比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「等效人眼散斑相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相機量得的對比是多個獨立變動來源的平方和：真正的散斑、散粒雜訊、像素響應不均（PRNU）與照明的低頻不均。要得到真正的散斑對比必須逐項估算並扣除；低頻不均可用高通濾波或局部平均正規化去除，但濾波尺度必須遠大於散斑顆粒，否則連散斑一起濾掉。另一個常被忽略的是部分相關：相鄰時間的圖樣若沒有完全去相關，有效 N 小於名目值，C 對曝光時間的曲線會比 1/√N 平緩並提早飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對比雜訊預算與飽和曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑抑制最後要放進真實的投影機：照明的發散角受 DMD 或 LCOS 接受角與投影鏡頭 F 數限制，擴散片產生的角度若超出投影鏡頭的光展量就會被裁掉，變成光損而不是散斑改善。因此 R_角 的上限其實是投影鏡頭出瞳對屏幕的張角與觀察者瞳孔張角之比，與擴散片多強無關。要再往下降，只能在屏幕端加入多樣性（振動屏幕）、擴大波長分布，或在 RGB 純雷射與雷射螢光粉架構間取捨：螢光粉轉換出的光是寬頻非同調光，本身幾乎沒有散斑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭光瞳與振動屏幕」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散斑驗收要涵蓋人眼與機器兩種觀察者：等效人眼相機（3 mm 入瞳、約 50 ms 曝光）評估觀感，短曝光工業相機（例如 1 ms）評估量測用途，兩者時間平均的圖樣數相差數十倍。驗收矩陣包含紅綠藍三色、屏幕多個位置與多個觀看角度，並記錄光源頻寬、擴散片軌跡與屏幕型號。移動件是散斑抑制系統的壽命瓶頸，交接資料要包含疲勞週期、噪音與失效時的退化特徵，因為擴散片一旦停止，散斑會立刻回到接近完全發展的水準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣與壽命紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: When coherent light strikes a screen rougher than a wavelength, every resolution cell of the observer contains many scattered wavelets of random phase that add as complex amplitudes on the retina or sensor, forming a random phasor sum. With fully random phases and many scatterers the intensity follows a negative-exponential distribution and the speckle contrast C = σ_I/⟨I⟩ = 1, called fully developed speckle; a depolarizing screen splits the light into two independent polarization patterns and C falls to 1/√2. The eye sees subjective speckle whose grain size is set by the observer's pupil rather than the screen, so the same picture shows coarser, more visible speckle in bright surroundings where the pupil contracts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Screen roughness and observer pupil”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The only way to lower speckle is to stack, within one observer resolution cell and one integration time, N mutually uncorrelated speckle patterns of similar intensity; intensity addition gives C = 1/√N. Independent patterns come from three diversities: illumination angle (the solid-angle ratio of projection pupil to observer pupil), polarization (at most two patterns) and wavelength (source bandwidth relative to the decorrelation wavelength set by the screen's path-length spread). They multiply into a total reduction factor R = R_angle·R_pol·R_λ, each with a physical ceiling, so design first converts the target C into the required N and then allocates it among the three. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle, polarization and wavelength diversity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Angle diversity has to be delivered in time, most often by a moving diffuser near an intermediate image or pupil: each time the diffuser moves one correlation length the screen speckle becomes a new independent pattern. Rotating diffusers are fast but bulky and limited by bearing life; compact diffusers on electroactive-polymer membranes drive x and y electrodes 90° apart in phase to produce circular motion, avoiding the stall at the turning points of a linear stroke and the retracing of the same path. The key point is that however many patterns appear in time, the effective N is capped by the number of angles N_angle the projection pupil can hold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Moving diffuser and correlation length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Another route is to make the source carry diversity itself: multi-emitter laser-diode arrays have an inherent wavelength spread and modulated drive current can broaden the line, while a multimode fiber divides the light among tens of thousands of modes with different group velocities. The modes are still mutually coherent, though, and the fiber output becomes many mutually incoherent speckle patterns only when the maximum intermodal path difference exceeds the source coherence length, so a single-frequency laser in a multimode fiber still emerges full of speckle. Step-index fiber has far more modal dispersion than graded-index fiber, which here is an advantage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multimode fiber and source bandwidth”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle contrast is not an intrinsic number of a screen or source but a quantity defined for a particular detector: the detector aperture sets grain size and how much angle diversity is collected, pixel size sets spatial integration and exposure time sets temporal averaging. To judge what the eye sees, the measuring camera must emulate the eye: placed at the viewing position, with an entrance pupil equal to the eye pupil, focused on the screen, sampling each grain with at least two pixels and exposing for about the eye's integration time. Any mismatch biases C systematically up or down and makes numbers from different laboratories incomparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Eye-equivalent speckle camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The contrast a camera reads is a sum of squares of independent variations: true speckle, shot noise, pixel response non-uniformity (PRNU) and low-frequency illumination non-uniformity. Recovering the true speckle contrast means estimating and subtracting each term; low-frequency non-uniformity is removed by high-pass filtering or local-mean normalisation, with a filter scale far larger than the grain, otherwise speckle is filtered away too. Another often-ignored factor is partial correlation: if successive patterns are not fully decorrelated, the effective N is below nominal and the C-versus-exposure curve is shallower than 1/√N and saturates early. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Contrast noise budget and saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle reduction must finally fit inside a real projector: illumination divergence is limited by the DMD or LCOS acceptance angle and the projection-lens F-number, and any diffuser angle beyond the lens étendue is clipped, turning into light loss rather than speckle improvement. The ceiling on R_angle is therefore the ratio of the angle the projection exit pupil subtends at the screen to that of the observer pupil, regardless of diffuser strength. Going lower requires diversity at the screen (a vibrating screen), a wider wavelength spread, or a trade between RGB pure-laser and laser-phosphor architectures, since phosphor-converted light is broadband and incoherent and carries almost no speckle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection pupil and vibrating screen”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Speckle acceptance must cover two kinds of observer: an eye-equivalent camera (3 mm entrance pupil, about 50 ms exposure) for perceived quality and a short-exposure industrial camera (for example 1 ms) for measurement use, whose time-averaged pattern counts differ by tens of times. The acceptance matrix covers red, green and blue, several screen positions and several viewing angles, and records source bandwidth, diffuser trajectory and screen model. Moving parts are the lifetime bottleneck of a speckle-reduction system, so the handoff must include fatigue cycles, acoustic noise and degradation signatures, because the moment a diffuser stops the speckle returns to nearly fully developed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix and lifetime record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在暗室評估時觀察者瞳孔約 6 mm，散斑細到難以察覺而判定合格；產品裝進明亮大廳後瞳孔縮到 2 到 3 mm，顆粒變粗一倍以上，畫面出現閃爍砂粒感，客訴才出現。
供應商報告寫散斑對比 2%，但量測用 F/2 鏡頭與 10 ms 曝光；以等效人眼設定重量得 6%。採購依報告數字比價，選中了實際最差的方案。
pitfallsEn: Evaluated in a dark room with observer pupils near 6 mm, the speckle is too fine to notice and the design passes; installed in a bright lobby the pupils shrink to 2 to 3 mm, the grain more than doubles, the picture takes on a sparkling sandy texture and only then do complaints arrive.

A supplier report quotes 2% speckle contrast measured with an F/2 lens and 10 ms exposure; re-measured with eye-equivalent settings it reads 6%, and purchasing, comparing reported numbers, selects the option that is actually worst.

related.transfer: 可遷移「散斑的形成與統計」與「散斑對比的量測方法」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；數位微鏡光學引擎的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Speckle formation and statistics" and "Measuring speckle contrast" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Digital-micromirror optical engines must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦散斑統計、1/√N 多樣性預算、移動擴散片、光纖去同調、等效人眼量測與投影光展量限制；數位微鏡光學引擎則以以微鏡傾角、f 數、繞射級與光展量為核心的 DMD 照明、投影與圖樣投射引擎工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on speckle statistics, 1/√N diversity budgets, moving diffusers, fiber decoherence, eye-equivalent measurement and projector étendue limits; Digital-micromirror optical engines centres on DMD illumination, projection and pattern-projection engine design built on mirror tilt, f-number, diffraction orders and étendue, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Screen roughness and observer pupil” and “±12° mirror tilt and illumination incidence”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雷射散斑抑制
history.text: 雷射在 1960 年問世後不久，研究者就注意到被照亮的粗糙表面布滿閃爍亮點；1962 至 1963 年 Rigden、Gordon 與 Oliver 等人描述了這種顆粒現象，史丹佛大學的 Joseph Goodman 隨後建立散斑的統計理論，並在 2007 年出版《Speckle Phenomena in Optics》專書。2002 年 Silicon Light Machines 的 Jahja Trisnadi 以角度、偏振與波長多樣性相乘的架構分析雷射投影的散斑抑制，並以 Hadamard 相位擴散片在光柵光閥投影機上把對比由約 70% 降到 8%；其後電活性聚合物振動擴散片等小型元件與 RGB 純雷射投影一同普及。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Soon after the laser appeared in 1960, researchers noticed that illuminated rough surfaces were covered with sparkling spots; in 1962 and 1963 Rigden, Gordon and Oliver among others described the granularity, and Joseph Goodman at Stanford went on to build the statistical theory of speckle, later collected in his 2007 book Speckle Phenomena in Optics. In 2002 Jahja Trisnadi of Silicon Light Machines analysed speckle reduction in laser projection as a product of angle, polarization and wavelength diversity and used a Hadamard phase diffuser on a grating-light-valve projector to cut contrast from about 70% to 8%; compact devices such as electroactive-polymer oscillating diffusers then spread together with RGB pure-laser projection. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「散斑的形成與統計」到「系統驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Speckle formation and statistics" through "System acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
